The third row is the one to sit with. At half your losses relieved the system still has an edge, it is still positive, and the test now needs 11,596 trades rather than 589. Lesson 76 counted thirteen orders in twenty-eight days for this book, which is 117 a year, so 11,596 trades is 99 years. At lesson 65’s forty a month it is twenty-four years. The edge did not disappear. It moved out of reach of measurement, which for a person deciding whether to keep running the system is the same thing.

And the concession that costs most: this page has priced what a rate does to the test and said nothing about what any of it does to the person. It has assumed throughout that this activity is the thing you do, that the hours in lesson 76 and the machinery in lesson 77 and the rate here are all costs of a job rather than of a hobby, and it has never asked whether the job exists. Lesson 79 asks that, and finds the capital that has to stand behind a tenth of an R to pay a wage is 11.40 years of the wage, while the verdict on whether the tenth of an R is there at all is 10.07 years away at the same pace.
